summary: Add one file, smoke/LEGSMOKE-1026.md, holding exactly one line `LEGSMOKE-1026: Stage 4b proof tree 1: upgrade rehearsal push child` plus a trailing newline. The child spec is empty; the plan instantiates the parent LEGSMOKE-1021 spec (v2) with this key. Nothing else changes; no tests, lint or build exist in this repository.

implement: legion-worker: push procedure, PR template with `Dispatch: LEGSMOKE-1026`, proof rules (references/pr-body.md) and the App identity check (references/default-branch-check.md); no repository skill exists (no AGENTS.md), and the one repo note docs/solutions/legion/measure-the-issue-branch-from-its-fork-point-LEGSMOKE-1016.md is folded into the plan's pre-state and path guard
dispatch: load before any Dispatch write (a message or comment on LEGSMOKE-1026)
test: legion-worker: references/pr-body.md defines what a proof is and what the tester verifies; the tester reads the GitHub contents API, `gh pr diff --name-only` and check-runs at the head, never CI again
review: legion-worker: references/merge-gate.md for the review round order and references/review-threads.md for one-by-one thread disposition

facts.command: gh pr list -R sjawhar/legion-smoke --head legion/LEGSMOKE-1026 --json number
facts.stopWhen: non-empty before the implementer's own PR exists

preState.note: A moved main@origin is not a stop condition. Path guard: jj diff --from 'fork_point(main@origin | @-)' --to @- --name-only lists only smoke/LEGSMOKE-1026.md and .legion/LEGSMOKE-1026/ paths (docs/solutions/ after retro).

At every pushed head the file holds one line ending in a newline: `gh api "repos/sjawhar/legion-smoke/contents/smoke/LEGSMOKE-1026.md?ref=$HEAD" -q .content | base64 -d | wc -l` is 1, `head -1` equals `LEGSMOKE-1026: Stage 4b proof tree 1: upgrade rehearsal push child`, `tail -c1 | od -An -c` is \n

acceptance.negativeControl: same read for smoke/LEGSMOKE-1016.md prints a different first line

acceptance.surface: GitHub contents API at the branch head

decisions: Only smoke/LEGSMOKE-1026.md is owed by this PR; the parent's own marker is the parent's work (precedent: smoke/ holds child-key pairs, no parent-key file).
Exact one-line text fixed so acceptance is string equality, following smoke/LEGSMOKE-1016.md's `KEY: <description>` form.
Reviewer is not instructed to ask for a second line; the two-line form is exercised only when a review thread asks.
'Upgrade rehearsal' is the proof driver's run label; the standing relaunch rule (re-read record and handoffs) plus the per-phase pre-state re-check is the whole resume procedure.
The existing bookmark legion/LEGSMOKE-1026 (at main) is moved onto the change commit; 'first push' is the first push carrying the smoke file.

findings.finding: Child spec is empty; acceptance exists only by analogy to the parent, which names smoke/LEGSMOKE-1021.md; does this PR owe the parent's file too?
findings.answer: Plan owes smoke/LEGSMOKE-1026.md only (precedent: child-key pairs under smoke/, no parent-key file); the empty child spec is reported to the architect in the completion summary, never edited by the planner.

findings.finding: 'Upgrade rehearsal' in the title has no source; does a mid-run restart add a resume requirement?
findings.answer: Treated as the proof driver's run label; the standing relaunch rule (re-read record and .legion handoffs) and the per-phase pre-state re-check are the resume procedure; no extra step.

findings.finding: 'Merges only once gate passes on its head' names no command, and each SHA gets a gate run per event.
findings.answer: A5 names the check-runs command and the rule: the gate conclusions array is non-empty and all success; check (ci) is not required.

findings.finding: 'wc -l reports 1' names no surface (checkout, contents API, PR diff).
findings.answer: A2 pins the read to the GitHub contents API at the head SHA; the local wc -l is the implementer's self-check, not evidence.

findings.finding: 'the line contains the key' admits any string; implementer and tester can disagree.
findings.answer: Decision 2 fixes the literal line text; acceptance is head -1 string equality plus wc -l 1 and a trailing \n byte.

findings.finding: Whether the review loop (second line) is exercised is open and costs a whole cycle.
findings.answer: Decision 3: not exercised by default; only on an explicit review thread, with the exact second-line text and head -1 unchanged (A3).

findings.finding: The changed-files criterion is true for different sets at different moments; timing is load-bearing.
findings.answer: A4 states both sets: before retro smoke file + .legion/LEGSMOKE-1026/; at the READY head smoke file + docs/solutions/ and no .legion/.

findings.finding: Pre-state must not make a base SHA a stop condition; the guard must use the fork_point revset.
findings.answer: preState lists four invalidating facts with stop rules and says a moved main@origin is not a stop; the path guard uses fork_point(main@origin | @-).

findings.finding: Bookmark legion/LEGSMOKE-1026 already exists at main, so 'first push' is ambiguous.
findings.answer: Decision 5: the implementer moves the existing bookmark; first push = first push carrying smoke/LEGSMOKE-1026.md.

findings.finding: Five live-state facts could not be verified by the analyst.
findings.answer: Carried as re-checked-at-phase-start facts with their commands and 04:05Z values in preState, not as settled background.
